name: anime-core
description: A story-agnostic engine for code-rendered, cel-anime-style shorts (three.js, headless capture, procedural audio). Distilled from Sunshower / LEVIATHAN.

scripts.model: node tools/turnaround.mjs --name star --at 0,5.92,-4 --facing 180 --height 3.7 --head 3.0 --exprs open,closed,happy,squint --mouth happy=1,squint=0.6 --sheet dino
scripts.player: node tools/build-player.mjs --video out/star/star.mp4 --out dist/star.html --title 星のかけら
scripts.build: node tools/render-audio.mjs --name star && node tools/render.mjs --name star && node tools/build-player.mjs --video out/star/star.mp4 --out dist/star.html --title 星のかけら
